# Price the stay, then check the kennel.

> Free calculator for independent dog boarding and daycare facility owners: price a reservation from staff time, supplies, overhead, a long-stay discount, and a multi-dog discount, then check whether your kennel/run occupancy clears a monthly break-even.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
